description: Lists the articles staged on this site with their review state. Use it to see which drafts are waiting, published or rejected before revising one. Returns slug, title, status (draft, pending, published, rejected), review note and current revision for each. Requires a team key (scope posts:read).
name: cotal_list_my_posts

http_status.description: HTTP status of the underlying /v1 request (200, 201 or 202).

id.description: Id of the stored record, when one was created or found.

ok.description: true when the call was accepted.

rate_limit_remaining.description: Calls left in the current rate-limit window.

replayed.description: true when an Idempotency-Key retry returned the original record.

sandbox.description: true when this was a sandbox (dry-run) call and nothing was stored.

title: List my staged articles
